description: This file is a shell script used for testing the `git check-ref-format` command, which validates and normalizes Git references. It defines functions to test valid and invalid reference names, runs various test cases, and verifies the behavior of reference formatting and normalization within a Git repository context.

methods.name: valid_ref
methods.description: Tests that a given reference name is recognized as valid by `git check-ref-format`, with optional additional flags.

methods.name: invalid_ref
methods.description: Tests that a given reference name is recognized as invalid by `git check-ref-format`, with optional additional flags.

methods.name: valid_ref_normalized
methods.description: Verifies that `git check-ref-format --normalize` simplifies a reference name to the expected normalized form.

methods.name: invalid_ref_normalized
methods.description: Checks that `git check-ref-format --normalize` rejects invalid reference names.
